title: The Bookshop on the Corner
text:
The shop is narrow and rather dark, and the shelves reach all the way to the ceiling. Books are stacked on the floor in towers that look ready to fall but somehow never do.
Mr Chandran has run the place since before I was born. He does not use a computer. When you ask for a title, he pauses, tilts his head, and then walks straight to a shelf and pulls it out.
There is a bigger bookshop in the mall three streets away, with air-conditioning and a cafe. It is brighter, cleaner and far easier to search.
But when I want a book I cannot name, and can only describe, I go to Mr Chandran.
